lines.zh: 嗡嗡作响，缓缓行走于黑暗之中。
lines.en: Humming softly, moving slowly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 轻盈地飘浮着，发出诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Floating lightly, emitting eerie light.

lines.zh: 挥动着细长的触须，探索四周。
lines.en: Swinging long tendrils, exploring the surroundings.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的呢喃，似乎在编织梦境。
lines.en: Muttering softly, as if weaving dreams.

lines.zh: 缓缓张开双翼，飘向远处的圣髑。
lines.en: Slowly spreading wings, drifting towards distant relics.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中穿梭，光芒闪烁不定。
lines.en: Moving through the darkness, light flickering.

lines.zh: 飘浮在空中，发出奇异的声响。
lines.en: Floating in the air, making strange sounds.

lines.zh: 轻盈地游荡，注视着远方。
lines.en: Moving gracefully, gazing into the distance.

lines.zh: 轻轻振动翅膀，缓缓向前移动。
lines.en: Gently flapping wings, moving forward.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中穿梭，似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Moving through the darkness, as if searching for something.

lines.zh: 四角的灵魂球在为我转动。
lines.en: The soul orbs at four corners turn for me.
I drift over cold tomb slabs.

lines.zh: 静静悬浮，发出柔和的光辉。
lines.en: Floating quietly, emitting soft light.

lines.zh: 静止不动，发出微弱的呢喃。
lines.en: Standing still, making soft mutters.

lines.zh: 缓缓摆动着长触须，显得悠然自得。
lines.en: Gently swaying long tendrils, looking at ease.

lines.zh: 轻飘飘地停留在空中，发出轻微的声音。
lines.en: Floating in the air, making soft noises.

lines.zh: 慢慢旋转，发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Slowly spinning, emitting faint light.

lines.zh: 静静悬浮，发出神秘的光辉。
lines.en: Floating quietly, emitting mysterious light.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中静静漂浮，偶尔发出呢喃。
lines.en: Drifting quietly in the darkness, muttering occasionally.

lines.zh: 轻盈地漂浮，偶尔发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Gently floating, emitting faint light occasionally.

lines.zh: 轻轻摆动触须，发出轻微的声音。
lines.en: Gently swaying tendrils, making soft noises.

lines.zh: 在空中缓缓漂浮，显得悠然自得。
lines.en: Drifting gently in the air, looking at ease.

lines.zh: 这座古墓是我最后的织机。
lines.en: This tomb is my last loom.
Threads run through my fingers, one by one.
I count the years I was locked away.

lines.zh: 墙上的名字都是我的作品。
lines.en: Every name on the wall is my work.
Do not touch the orbs at the corners.

lines.zh: 圣髑堂安静得像一块布。
lines.en: The reliquary lies still as cloth.

lines.zh: 突然注意到了你，发出警告的声音。
lines.en: Suddenly notices you, emitting a warning sound.

lines.zh: 注意到你了，发出低沉的警告声。
lines.en: Notices you, making a low warning sound.

lines.zh: 看向你，发出轻微的警告声。
lines.en: Looks at you, making a soft warning sound.

lines.zh: 注意到了你，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Notices you, making a low sound.

lines.zh: 看向你，发出警告的呢喃。
lines.en: Looks at you, making a warning mutter.

lines.zh: 发现你了，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Finds you, making a low sound.

lines.zh: 注意到你，发出警告的声音。
lines.en: Notices you, emitting a warning sound.

lines.zh: 注意到了你，发出低沉的呢喃。
lines.en: Notices you, making a low mutter.

lines.zh: 看向你，发出警告的声音。
lines.en: Looks at you, emitting a warning sound.
You have fresh thread on you.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看着一团材料。
lines.en: I look at you as raw material.
Your breathing disturbs my silk.
How many soul orbs did you bring?

lines.zh: 我记得上一个来的家伙。
lines.en: I remember the last one who came.
Your steps are heavy; they snap threads.
Do not look at me; look at the corners.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里还有光，真可惜。
lines.en: Your eyes still hold light. A pity.
Pain echoes in my heart.
Souls decay.

lines.zh: 灵魂球不在容器里，我就打不动。
lines.en: No soul orbs in the vessels, no wounds on me.
My weaving is torn.
I cannot sustain this.
The threads of souls will snap.
My strength is fading.
The fabric of souls begins to unravel.
Weaving is becoming harder.
One soul orb still stands between us.

lines.zh: 诱惑你的心，编织你的魂。
lines.en: Lure your heart, weave your soul.

lines.zh: 你是我的织线，你的魂是我珍宝。
lines.en: You are my thread, my soul is the treasure.

lines.zh: 来吧，成为我永生的一部分。
lines.en: Come, be part of my eternal being.

lines.zh: 你的勇气激发我的创造。
lines.en: Your courage fuels my creation.

lines.zh: 你的力量将我从尘封中唤醒。
lines.en: Your power awakens me from my封印中.
Feel the art of soul weaving.
Your will cannot bind me.
Your greed will bring灾祸.

lines.zh: 你的牺牲将赐予我力量。
lines.en: Your sacrifice will give me power.
Your soul is with me.

lines.zh: 触碰我者，受我织网所困。
lines.en: Those who touch me, are caught in my web.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，织成了我的牢笼。
lines.en: Your collision, weaves my cage.

lines.zh: 灵魂的触碰，织成不可见的牢。
lines.en: Soul touch, weaves an invisible cage.

lines.zh: 你的力量，只会使我更强。
lines.en: Your power, only strengthens me.

lines.zh: 你触碰不到，却能感受到我。
lines.en: You cannot touch me, but you feel me.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，织成了我的梦魇。
lines.en: Your collision, weaves my nightmare.
The closer you get, the stronger I am.

lines.zh: 你的力量，织不成我的网。
lines.en: Your strength, cannot weave my net.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，只是织者的一丝笑。
lines.en: Your collision, is just the weaver's smirk.

lines.zh: 你的力量，只能织成更紧的束缚。
lines.en: Your power, only tightens the bonds.
Soul mate, my thread.

lines.zh: 灵魂织得出，伴侣织不出。
lines.en: I can weave souls, not a partner.
Merge with you, the soul is perfect.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂，织成了我的伴侣。
lines.en: Your soul, weaves my mate.

lines.zh: 你是我织造的终极作品。
lines.en: You are my ultimate weaving.
Coexist with you, the soul is whole.

lines.zh: 你的存在，织成了我的梦想。
lines.en: Your existence, weaves my dream.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，织成了我的旋律。
lines.en: Your heartbeat, weaves my melody.
Merge with you, the soul shines brighter.

lines.zh: 最后一个同类，早已成了布。
lines.en: The last of my kind became cloth long ago.

lines.zh: 触碰我，你将学会什么叫做恐惧！
lines.en: Feel fear, for you have touched me!
The net of souls will bind you!
The power of the Weaver of Souls!

lines.zh: 你无法伤害我，但可以赢我！
lines.en: You can't hurt me, but you can win me!
Soul spheres, your targets!
Soul fragments, hidden in the shadows!
The Crypt, your journey's end!

lines.zh: 我以灵魂为食，永不饥饿！
lines.en: I feast on souls, never hungry!

lines.zh: 每一寸灵魂，都织成我的力量！
lines.en: Every soul woven into my power!

lines.zh: 灵魂之链，缚住你的灵魂！
lines.en: Soul chains, bind your soul!
Soul fragments, close at hand!
Divine light, guide your path!
The Weaver of Souls awakens!
You cannot escape my net!
Soul spheres, gather strength!
Soul blossoms, about to bloom!

lines.zh: 灵魂之火，燃烧你的灵魂！
lines.en: Soul flames, burning your soul!
The Weaver of Souls, invincible!
The net of souls, tightening!
The Weaver of Souls, eternal!
You carry a soul orb; good.
The loom begins to turn.
Soul spheres, target the mark!
Soul eyes, glimpse the future!
The Weaver of Souls, weaves destiny!
Soul hands, touch life!
The Weaver of Souls, omnipresent!
The net of souls, no gaps!
The Weaver of Souls, your nightmare!
Soul spheres, shatter all!
The Weaver of Souls, unstoppable!
The net of souls, captures souls!
The orb is one step from the vessel.

lines.zh: 你手上的抖，我数到三次了。
lines.en: Three times now, your hands have shaken.
The corners grow louder.
Silk tangles around your boots.

lines.zh: 我等着你手里的球滚落。
lines.en: I wait for your orb to fall.

lines.zh: 你的魂魄要被织成什么？
lines.en: What will your soul be woven into?
Feel the weaver’s magic!

lines.zh: 你的魂线正好够我一织。
lines.en: Your soul thread is just long enough.
You can’t escape my weave!

lines.zh: 你的力量在我面前不足为惧！
lines.en: Your power is nothing before me!
Soul balls, my treasures!
The weaver’s power comes from here!
Your efforts are in vain!
Feel the weave of death!

lines.zh: 你的影子被我抽走一缕。
lines.en: I pull a strand from your shadow.
Soul breath, here it comes!

lines.zh: 古墓之中，我是最后的织者！
lines.en: In the ancient tomb, I am the last weaver!
Soul fragments, my tokens!
Gather soul balls!
Soul light, guide your way!
The weaving of souls never stops!
Soul puzzle, solve it!
Soul puzzle, revealed!
The source of souls, I control it!

lines.zh: 灵魂之光，照亮你的失败！
lines.en: Soul light, illuminate your failure!

lines.zh: 我是被锁在此处的最后一位。
lines.en: I am the last one locked in here.
You do not have the key, do you?
After millennia of weaving, even I tire.
This tomb was meant for me.
To hurt me, learn to move the orbs.
The silk is taut; make your move.
Flames consume me.
The fall unravels my woven soul.
Water swallows me.
Explosion tears my weaving.
Arrows pierce my weaving.
Magic eats at my power.
Hunger devours my soul.
Lightning tears through me.

lines.zh: 虚空扯断了我一根魂线。
lines.en: The void snapped one of my soul threads.
